# Capstone 2: tudo, a TUI Task Manager

`tudo` is an interactive Terminal User Interface (TUI) task management utility written with `ratatui` and `crossterm`. It demonstrates stateful widget rendering, keyboard event loops, modal dialogs, and atomic JSON persistence.

## Dependencies

```toml
[package]
name = "tudo"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"

[dependencies]
ratatui = "0.26"
crossterm = "0.27"
serde = { version = "1.0", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1.0"
anyhow = "1.0"
dirs = "5.0"
```

## Data Model and Persistence

```rust
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Debug)]
pub struct Task {
    pub id: usize,
    pub title: String,
    pub completed: bool,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Default)]
pub struct TaskList {
    pub tasks: Vec<Task>,
    pub next_id: usize,
}

impl TaskList {
    pub fn add(&mut self, title: String) {
        self.tasks.push(Task {
            id: self.next_id,
            title,
            completed: false,
        });
        self.next_id += 1;
    }

    pub fn toggle(&mut self, index: usize) {
        if let Some(task) = self.tasks.get_mut(index) {
            task.completed = !task.completed;
        }
    }

    pub fn delete(&mut self, index: usize) {
        if index < self.tasks.len() {
            self.tasks.remove(index);
        }
    }
}
```

## Interactive Event Loop

```rust
use crossterm::event::{self, Event, KeyCode};
use ratatui::{
    layout::{Constraint, Layout},
    style::{Color, Modifier, Style},
    widgets::{Block, Borders, List, ListItem},
    Frame,
};
use std::time::Duration;

pub struct App {
    pub list: TaskList,
    pub selected_index: usize,
    pub should_quit: bool,
}

impl App {
    pub fn update(&mut self) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
        if event::poll(Duration::from_millis(100))? {
            if let Event::Key(key) = event::read()? {
                match key.code {
                    KeyCode::Char('q') | KeyCode::Esc => self.should_quit = true,
                    KeyCode::Char('j') | KeyCode::Down => {
                        if !self.list.tasks.is_empty() {
                            self.selected_index = (self.selected_index + 1) % self.list.tasks.len();
                        }
                    }
                    KeyCode::Char('k') | KeyCode::Up => {
                        if !self.list.tasks.is_empty() {
                            self.selected_index = self.selected_index.checked_sub(1)
                                .unwrap_or(self.list.tasks.len() - 1);
                        }
                    }
                    KeyCode::Char(' ') => self.list.toggle(self.selected_index),
                    KeyCode::Char('d') => self.list.delete(self.selected_index),
                    _ => {}
                }
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn render(&self, frame: &mut Frame) {
        let area = frame.size();
        let items: Vec<ListItem> = self.list.tasks
            .iter()
            .enumerate()
            .map(|(i, task)| {
                let status = if task.completed { "[x]" } else { "[ ]" };
                let content = format!("{status} {}", task.title);
                let mut style = Style::default();
                if i == self.selected_index {
                    style = style.fg(Color::Yellow).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD);
                }
                ListItem::new(content).style(style)
            })
            .collect();

        let widget = List::new(items)
            .block(Block::default().title("tudo - Task Manager (j/k: nav, space: toggle, d: del, q: quit)").borders(Borders::ALL));

        frame.render_widget(widget, area);
    }
}
```
